info.title: Beyonic API
info.description: Beyonic (now Onafriq, formerly MFS Africa) REST API for mobile money: payments (mobile money, airtime, bank), collection requests, collections, contacts, webhooks, accounts, transactions, events, networks, banks and currencies. Token authentication; paginated lists use {count, next, previous, results}. The OpenFn beyonic adaptor POSTs JSON to <apiUrl>/payments, /contacts and /collectionrequests with "Authorization: Token <apiToken>".

servers.description: Production; resolves to the API version saved on the account (or the Beyonic-Version header). The API root currently links resources under /api/v6.

parameters.name: payment_state
parameters.description: Individual payment status: new, processing, pending_confirmation, complete, error, paused, parked, paused_for_admin_action, queued, aborted.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Group payment status: new, validated, approval_needed, approval_requested, approved, rejected, scheduled, processed, processed_with_errors, cancelled.

post.description: Send mobile money, airtime or (with account_number/account_name/bank or contact_bank_account) a bank payment. Use recipient_data for multiple recipients. The new payment has state "new".

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: pending, instructions_sent, successful, failed, expired, reversed.

post.description: Ask a subscriber to pay you; set send_instructions=true to notify them. subscription_settings makes it recurring.

parameters.name: collection_request
parameters.description: ID of the matched collection request.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: pending, reversed, reversed_on_network, successful, failed, cashed_out, expired.

parameters.name: claim
parameters.description: True to search unmatched collections (with phonenumber, remote_transaction_id and amount) and claim them for your organization.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: ID of the user who created the webhook.

BeyonicVersion.name: Beyonic-Version
BeyonicVersion.description: Pin the API version (e.g. v1 ... v6); defaults to the version saved on your account.

DuplicateCheckKey.name: Duplicate-Check-Key
DuplicateCheckKey.description: Idempotency key; a repeat request with the same key returns 409.

Ordering.name: ordering
Ordering.description: Field to order by; prefix with - for descending (e.g. -created).

CreatedAfter.name: created_after
CreatedAfter.description: Only records created after this date (e.g. 2017-01-01 00:00).

CreatedBefore.name: created_before
CreatedBefore.description: Only records created before this date.

ModifiedAfter.name: modified_after
ModifiedAfter.description: Only records modified after this date.

ModifiedBefore.name: modified_before
ModifiedBefore.description: Only records modified before this date.

organization.description: ID of the organization the account belongs to.

currency.description: Currency code (e.g. KES); the nested account inside a Collection transaction shows a currency ID instead.

label.description: Account label (seen on the nested account in Collection samples).

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.

Bank.description: A bank supported for bank payments.

Collection.description: Funds received (collected) from a mobile subscriber.

remote_transaction_id.description: Transaction ID from the mobile network operator.

organization.description: ID of the organization the collection was matched to.

amount.description: The collection amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

phonenumber.description: Phone number the collection came from, international format.

reference.description: Reference the subscriber sent with the collection.

status.description: successful, failed, pending or cashed_out (filters also accept reversed, reversed_on_network, expired).

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.

CollectionRequest.description: A request asking a mobile subscriber to send funds to you.

organization.description: ID of the organization that owns the request.

amount.description: The collection request amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (BXC is the Beyonic test currency).

account.description: ID of the account the collection will be sent to.

phonenumber.description: Phone number the request is for, international format.

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata (up to 10 string attributes).

collection.description: ID of the collection that fulfilled the request, if any.

success_message.description: Confirmation SMS sent on successful payment.

send_instructions.description: Whether payment instructions are sent to the subscriber (defaults to false).

instructions.description: Override for the default instructions; "skip" sends none.

status.description: pending, pending_dispatched, processing_started, successful, failed, expired or reversed (filters also accept instructions_sent).

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.

CollectionVerificationRequest.description: JSON Beyonic POSTs to your Collection Verification URL; reply 200 with text "ACCEPT <remote_transaction_id>" or "REJECT <remote_transaction_id> [reason]" within 60 s.

Contact.description: A person you pay or collect from. Created automatically for new phone numbers.

organization.description: ID of the organization that owns the contact.

phone_number.description: Phone number in international format, starting with +.

type.description: One of employee, beneficiary, vendor, other, or a custom string.

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata (up to 10 string attributes).

phone_is_supported.description: Whether the phone network is supported (yes/no).

phone_is_mm_registered.description: Whether the phone is registered for mobile money (yes/no).

name_on_network.description: Name registered with the network, when available.

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.

reason.description: Reason sent with the instructions (keep under 20 characters).

metadata.description: Custom attributes; metadata.sync=1 requests instant contact verification (Uganda: Airtel, MTN, Msente; charged).

phonenumber.description: Recipient phone, international format. Required unless recipient_data is set.

amount.description: Amount without thousands separators (string, integer or decimal).

currency.description: 3-letter currency code. One of currency or account is required.

account.description: ID of the account to pay from. One of currency or account is required.

description.description: Sent to the recipient; keep to about 140 characters.

callback_url.description: Ignored from v5; only exists for older versions.

first_name.description: First name for a new contact.

last_name.description: Last name for a new contact.

national_id.description: National ID used to register the phone (set national_id_type too).

recipient_data.description: Multiple payments in one request: JSON list of {phonenumber, amount, first_name?, last_name?, description?}.

account_number.description: Bank payments: recipient bank account number.

account_name.description: Bank payments: name on the bank account.

contact_bank_account.description: Bank payments: existing contact bank account ID.

Error.description: Error body: usually {"detail": "..."}; validation errors map each field to a list of messages.

Event.description: Something that happened in your organization.

data.description: The object that triggered the event (Payment, Collection, Contact or CollectionRequest).

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.

phone_regex.description: POSIX regex for phone numbers on the network.

Payment.description: A mobile money, airtime or bank payment sent from your account.

organization.description: ID of the organization the payment belongs to.

amount.description: The payment amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

account.description: ID of the account the payment is made from.

description.description: Payment description sent to the recipient.

phone_nos.description: Recipients and amounts (v5+; before v5 a list of phone-number strings).

start_date.description: When the payment is scheduled to be delivered (UTC).

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata (up to 10 string attributes).

state.description: new, validated, approval_needed, approval_requested, approved, rejected, scheduled, processed, processed_with_errors or cancelled.

send_sms_message.description: Whether the description is also sent as an SMS.

author.description: ID of the user who created the object.

modified.description: When the object was last modified (UTC).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the object.

PaymentRecipient.description: One recipient of a payment (v5+ phone_nos entry).

amount.description: Amount sent to this recipient. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

state.description: Individual payment state: new, processing, pending_confirmation, complete, error, paused, parked, paused_for_admin_action, queued, aborted.

SubscriptionSettings.description: Recurring collection request settings. Dates use DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS (UTC).

end_date.description: Subscription end; must be after start_date.

frequency.description: Comma-separated: yearly, monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, minutely.

Transaction.description: A movement of funds on an account.

account.description: Account ID; expanded to an Account object when nested in a Collection (v4+).

amount.description: Transaction amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

currency.description: Currency code (present on the nested transaction in Collection samples).

type.description: admin_funds_update, mobile_funds_update, funds_deposit, funds_adjustment, mobile_collection, mobile_payment, airtime_topup, service_charge, mobile_withdrawal or bank_withdrawal.

fee_transaction.description: Related fee transaction, if any (type not documented).

Webhook.description: A callback URL subscribed to one event type.

user.description: ID of the user who created the webhook.

updated.description: When the webhook was last modified (UTC).

target.description: HTTPS URL events are POSTed to.

WebhookNotification.description: Body Beyonic POSTs to a webhook target when an event fires.

data.description: The object that triggered the event.
